title: PostPilot

basics.tagline: AI Social Media Content & Publishing Platform

listing.shortDescription: A centralized AI workspace that turns YouTube videos, trending topics, prompts and uploaded files into platform-specific posts — with scheduling, publishing and analytics for seven networks in one dashboard.
listing.fullDescription: PostPilot is a centralized AI-powered social media platform. Users start with a YouTube video, a trending topic, a custom prompt or an uploaded document, and the platform generates platform-specific copy through multiple AI models. Blotato handles automated publishing, Higgsfield generates video assets, and a draft-review workflow keeps humans in control — all from one workspace covering LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, TikTok, Pinterest and Threads.

cover.imageAlt: PostPilot — AI Social Media Content & Publishing Platform

closing.clientOverview: Content teams and creators with long-form content who need it repurposed across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, TikTok, Pinterest and Threads without switching between disconnected tools.
closing.conclusion: PostPilot turns a single source — a video, a topic, a prompt or a document — into a complete multi-platform campaign. From AI generation through human review, scheduling and publishing, the entire workflow lives in one workspace, and analytics closes the loop on what performs where.

challenge.summary: Creating content is easy compared with consistently distributing it across every relevant channel. Each network demands a different format, style and publishing workflow, so repurposing becomes a full-time job.

points.title: One piece, many platforms
points.description: A long-form YouTube video holds dozens of ideas, but converting them into platform-specific posts takes significant time.

points.title: Different platform requirements
points.description: LinkedIn, Instagram, X, Facebook, TikTok, Pinterest and Threads each need different styles and formats. One piece of text cannot simply be copied everywhere.

points.title: Too many disconnected tools
points.description: Content creation, AI writing, image and video generation, scheduling, media storage, analytics and account management each live in separate tools.

points.title: Manual content approval
points.description: AI output cannot always be published unreviewed — the workflow needed drafts, human review and approval before publishing.

points.title: Managing multiple accounts
points.description: Businesses and creators manage several accounts across several platforms, so account connection and management needed to be centralized.

solution.summary: PostPilot was built as a centralized AI content operating system: any content source flows through AI generation, platform adaptation and media generation into a review-and-publish workflow, with Blotato and Higgsfield handling publishing and video.

points.title: YouTube repurposing
points.description: Video URLs are processed through the content workflow to extract ideas, themes and talking points for every platform.

points.title: Blotato integration
points.description: Generated content moves toward publishing through Blotato without copy-pasting each post into individual networks.

points.title: Model selection layer
points.description: Claude, GPT, Llama, Gemini and others are selectable per task, with tone, length, language and hashtag controls.

points.title: Higgsfield video generation
points.description: Content concepts become generated visual and video assets as part of the same workflow.

points.title: Draft review workflow
points.description: AI output lands in Drafts first — users review, edit, replace media and approve before anything goes live.

points.title: One workspace
points.description: Content Studio, Social Accounts, Posts, Calendar, Media Library and Analytics replace the stack of disconnected tools.
